## Roles

- **maintainer** (human): Decides what the model means; reviews and merges

## Procedures and rules

- **check** (recipe): Typecheck, test, and validate every project manifest.
  - `npm run check`
- **instance-first** (obligation): Change a category in docs/model.md only together with the instance that forces it. Defined in AGENTS.md. _**not enforced: nothing fails if you skip it**._

## Continuity: so the next agent can pick up

- Branch name: `{agent}/{slug}`.
- Session record: HANDOFF.md, committed and pushed on the working branch. Update it after every meaningful step. Readable by local and cloud agents.

You can be stopped at any moment (usage limit, crash). Keep the records above current as you go;
